risks.risk: Camera does not power on or function correctly
risks.proof: Video clip of the camera turning on, navigating menus, and releasing the shutter

risks.risk: Shutter count is unknown or high
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count or actuations from the camera menu or connected software

risks.risk: Sensor has dust, scratches, or dead pixels
risks.proof: Photo of the exposed sensor or a test shot of a plain white surface

risks.risk: Buttons, dials, or autofocus do not work
risks.proof: Video showing all dials, buttons, and autofocus in operation
risks.if_unproven: priced as controls and autofocus unverified

risks.risk: Batteries and charger are missing or dead
risks.proof: Photo or video of two batteries and charger, plus demonstration that they hold a charge
risks.if_unproven: priced without a working battery and charger

risks.risk: No original warranty or purchase receipt
risks.proof: Photo of the original receipt or warranty documents
risks.if_unproven: priced with no warranty or proof of purchase

risks.risk: Hidden history of drops, repairs, or water damage
risks.proof: Detailed photos of body seams, LCD, and sensor for impact or corrosion, or seller's written history

risks.risk: USB, HDMI, or memory card slots do not work
risks.proof: Video of a cable connected to each port and a memory card being read
risks.if_unproven: priced as ports and slots unverified

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, navigating menus, and taking a photo
Photo of the two batteries and charger
Photo of the original receipt or warranty
Test shot of a plain white surface to check the sensor
response.reason: The witness identifies a Nikon D7100, so the item can be priced at its worst case; unproven functionality and accessories are listed with the proof needed to raise value.
